thread.title: Dialog Semiconductor expects Apple to order 30% fewer chips - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Dialog Semiconductor expects Apple to order 30% fewer chips - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) supplier Dialog Semiconductor ( OTCPK:DLGNF ) says the tech giant will order 30% fewer of its power management chips than previously expected.
The drop comes as Apple adds another supplier to the chain for this year’s iPhones. Dialog previously supplied all of the PMICs.
Analysts estimate that Dialog gets more than half of its revenue from the Apple supply deal. Dialog shares have lost more than half of their value in the past year in Frankfurt trade.
Dialog expects 2018 revenues to drop 5% due to Apple’s change but says revenue will still grow on the year.
The company expects a similar impact on 2019 revenue.
